items.excerpt: Adobe's Project Indigo experimental camera app adds AI Playground, bringing generative editing, object edits, style transforms and photo guidance to mobile photographers, powered by Google's Nano Banana model.

Samsung launched Health Assistant, an AI chatbot inside Samsung Health that interprets your wellness data and offers personalized, physician-validated lifestyle recommendations across its wearable ecosystem.

The Galaxy Watch 9 debuts Samsung's new AI health suite (FDA-cleared sleep apnea detection, Heart Health Score, Daily Cardio Load) on a Snapdragon Wear Elite chip with a dedicated NPU for on-device AI.
Friend relaunches its always-listening AI companion pendant as Friend 2.0 for $249, now with a built-in speaker for voice replies and a $10/month subscription for memory beyond 30 days.
Apple's AI smart glasses are reportedly slated to be unveiled at WWDC27 for a late-2027 release, with the company weighing camera-free or recording-restricted designs to address privacy concerns.
